title: Tissue Freezing in Cryostor Solution and Processing
author: Regina Hoo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgsnjwde
materials: Most tissue is collected in Hyperthermosol and kept on ice or at 4 °C .
Discard supernant. Proceed with preferred tissue digestion protocol

steps.title: Prepare and mince tissue
steps.instruction: Place tissue in a petri dish and mince it using two scalpels, as would be done for enzymatic digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add enough ice cold RPMI/10% FBS to cover the tissue (amount depends on tissue size).

steps.title: Collect and wash tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue and all remaining material into a 50ml falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer minced tissue into a 50ml falcon tube.
Wash and rinse the petri dish with plenty of RPMI/10% FBS.
Transfer the rinse RPMI/10% FBS and any remaining tissue pieces into the falcon tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend tissue
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tissue and resuspend it in Cryostor solution.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the tissue in 1 ml of ice cold CS10 and transfer into a cryovial.
Rinse the falcon tube with 0.8 ml of extra cold CS10 and transfer this into the cryovial.

steps.title: Freeze and store tissue
steps.instruction: Slow-freeze the cryovial and move it to long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Place cryovial in CoolCell and leave in -80 °C freezer overnight.
Remove cryovial from CoolCell the next day and store in a designated box in -80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw and process cryopreserved tissue
steps.instruction: Thaw the tissue and wash it using a centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Thaw cryovials in a water bath at 37 °C.
Transfer thawed tissue into a falcon tube containing 20ml warm RPMI/10% FBS.
Centrifuge at 500 x g for 4 minutes.
